title: Surreal Mosaic Dreamscape
description: A surreal scene featuring a large mosaic-style human face with orange eyes at center, a giant white lily flower growing from a mechanical elephant tank, and multiple smaller steampunk war elephants traversing a vibrant purple field of lavender and red poppies. A red brick wall stretches across the horizon beneath a glowing yellow sun with radiating pink beams.
